title: ChronoWorld: Camera-Controlled Consistent 4D World Generation via Spatiotemporal Cues and Geometric Reflections
title_zh: ChronoWorld:通过时空线索与几何反射实现相机可控的一致性4D世界生成

paragraphs.en: While existing camera-controllable video generation models can produce visually compelling sequences, preserving intrinsic 4D spatiotemporal coherence remains challenging. To address this limitation, we propose ChronoWorld , an “Observation–State–Reflection” framework that leverages spatiotemporal causal cues and reconstruction priors to generate globally consistent, free-view 4D scenes. Given a context video, we introduce a Spatiotemporal Epipolar Causal Attention mechanism that enforces multi-view epipolar constraints and temporal causality throughout the generation process. In addition, we develop a reconstruction-driven geometric reflection pipeline with a 4D retrieval strategy to enable dynamic self-assessment and correction of generated outputs, improving consistency and accuracy. Extensive experiments show that ChronoWorld achieves state-of-the-art performance in spatiotemporally consistent, cinematic-quality 4D scene generation, with strong generalization and high-fidelity geometry across diverse scenarios.

paragraphs.en: Despite these advances, a “Tower of Babel” gap persists between 2D video generation and 4D scene reconstruction. While current video generation models Wang et al. (2024) ; He et al. (2024) ; Li et al. (2025b) ; Geng et al. (2025) can produce visually plausible, pixel-level sequences, they struggle to maintain intrinsic 4D spatiotemporal consistency in the underlying scene representation. As a result, generated videos often violate multi-view geometric constraints, undermining both physical validity and temporal coherence. Recent approaches Yu et al. (2025) ; Liu et al. (2025) ; Song et al. (2025) ; Szymanowicz et al. (2025) attempt to mitigate this issue by incorporating projected 3D representations (e.g., point clouds) as multi-view guidance within iterative render–generate–update pipelines. However, constructing 3D representations from coarse reconstructions of generated outputs introduces a critical failure mode: errors in synthesized frames are back-projected and fused into the 3D prior, creating a self-reinforcing feedback loop that amplifies inconsistencies and can ultimately lead to collapse in subsequent generations.

(2025) 试图通过将投影的3D表示（例如点云）作为多视角引导融入迭代渲染-生成-更新流程中来缓解这一问题。 然而，从生成的输出结果的粗略重建中构建3D表示会引发一种关键故障模式：合成帧中的错误会被反向投影并融合到3D先验中，形成自我强化的反馈循环，从而放大不一致性，并最终可能导致后续生成过程崩溃。

paragraphs.en: Fundamentally, these challenges can be attributed to three key limitations: 1) 4D Spatiotemporal Inconsistency: Current models generate videos that violate 3D epipolar geometry and 4D spatiotemporal constraints, preventing the formation of a consistent and persistent scene representation. 2) Error Accumulation and Exposure Bias: Due to training–inference discrepancies and inherited artifacts, errors at inference time accumulate over time, leading to pronounced dynamic distortions and spatial drift. 3) Spatial Forgetting and Geometric Degradation: Over temporal horizons and complex camera motions, existing methods fail to preserve global coherence and handle occlusions, resulting in “spatial forgetting” that can cause severe geometric degradation or collapse.
paragraphs.zh: 从根本上说，这些挑战可归因于三个关键局限性：1) 四维时空不一致性：当前模型生成的视频违反了三维对极几何和四维时空约束，导致无法形成一致且持久的场景表示。2) 误差累积与曝光偏差：由于训练与推理之间的差异以及继承的伪影，推理时的错误会随时间不断累积，从而引发明显的动态畸变和空间漂移。3) 空间遗忘与几何退化：在长时间跨度及复杂相机运动下，现有方法无法保持全局连贯性并处理遮挡问题，进而导致“空间遗忘”，可能引起严重的几何退化或崩溃。

paragraphs.en: To address these challenges, we draw inspiration from human cognition and propose an “Observation–State–Reflection” framework, ChronoWorld, for camera-conditioned, globally consistent 4D scene generation. The framework extracts spatiotemporal cues from external inputs ( observations ), compresses them into a structured latent space via geometric invariants ( state ), and refines predictions through geometry-aware feedback ( reflection ), yielding a persistent and unified representation. At its core, we introduce a Spatiotemporal Epipolar Causal Attention mechanism that leverages contextual views to preserve intra- and inter-frame dependencies, while enforcing multi-view epipolar constraints and temporal causality. We further propose a Spatial Context Augmentation strategy integrated with rectified flow, where perturbed memory cues encourage robustness and reduce error accumulation and exposure bias during spatial transformations. In addition, we augment the video diffusion model with a reconstructive multi-head decoder that maps latent features to 4D Gaussian attributes and motion fields, supported by auxiliary representation supervision to enhance spatiotemporal consistency. To mitigate cumulative drift and address spatial forgetting and geometric degradation, we design a reconstruction-driven geometric reflection pipeline at inference time. Specifically, we build a unified 4D memory from feed-forward 4D Gaussians and global camera poses. An explicit 4D retrieval mechanism then evaluates generated outputs, filters inconsistent frames, and constructs a geometric consistency graph. Finally, we synchronize updates between the explicit memory and the implicit history cache to maintain accuracy and consistency over time. The main contributions of our work are summarized as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们从人类认知中汲取灵感，提出了一种名为“观察–状态–反思”（Observation–State–Reflection）的框架——ChronoWorld，用于生成受相机条件约束且全局一致的4D场景。 该框架从外部输入（观察）中提取时空线索，通过几何不变量将其压缩为结构化的潜在空间（状态），并通过感知几何的反馈（反思）优化预测结果，从而生成持久且统一的表示。 其核心是我们提出了一种时空极线因果注意力机制，该机制利用上下文视图来保留帧内和帧间依赖关系，同时强制执行多视角极线约束和时间因果性。 我们还提出了一种与校正流集成的空间上下文增强策略，其中经过扰动的记忆线索能够提升模型的鲁棒性，并减少空间变换过程中的误差累积和暴露偏差。 此外，我们通过在视频扩散模型中引入一个重构型多头解码器来增强其能力，该解码器可将潜在特征映射为4D高斯属性和运动场，并由辅助表示监督支持，以增强时空一致性。 为缓解累积漂移问题并解决空间遗忘和几何退化现象，我们在推理阶段设计了一条以重构为导向的几何反思流程。 具体而言，我们从前向传播的4D高斯分布和全局相机姿态中构建了一个统一的4D记忆。 随后，一个显式的4D检索机制会评估生成的输出，过滤不一致的帧，并构建一个几何一致性图。 最后，我们在显式记忆与隐式历史缓存之间同步更新，以在长时间运行中保持准确性和一致性。 我们工作的主要贡献总结如下：

paragraphs.en: Camera-Controlled Video Generation. Recent progress in video generation has been driven by large-scale diffusion models Yang et al. (2024b) ; Ge et al. (2025) ; Ma et al. (2025) ; Wan et al. (2025) and autoregressive transformer architectures Joseph and de Veciana (2014) ; Alhaija et al. (2025) . While these approaches achieve strong visual fidelity, conditioning on a single text or image input provides limited control over camera motion and restricts free-view exploration. Camera-conditioned methods Wang et al. (2024) ; He et al. (2024) ; Zhang et al. (2025a) incorporate trajectory signals to guide video synthesis along prescribed camera paths. However, preserving geometric fidelity and scene consistency under large viewpoint changes remains challenging. Warping-and-repainting approaches project images into point clouds and warp them along trajectories, which improves spatial alignment but often introduces artifacts in unseen regions. Joint RGB-depth generation enables point cloud reconstruction for novel-view rendering, yet several limitations persist in 4D inconsistency.

paragraphs.en: 3D and 4D Scene Generation. Existing 3D/4D generation methods can be broadly categorized into: (1) compositional scene generation Zhou et al. (2024) ; Po and Wetzstein (2024) ; Gao et al. (2024a) , which assembles scenes from discrete 3D assets using layouts or scene graphs, and (2) end-to-end volumetric generation, which directly models scenes using representations such as occupancy fields, point clouds, voxels, or meshes. Compositional approaches improve object diversity and controllability but often struggle with realistic backgrounds and object–environment interactions. In contrast, end-to-end methods better preserve global semantic consistency, yet are constrained by limited 3D data, high annotation costs, and lower visual fidelity, and they do not fully benefit from large-scale 2D pretraining.
paragraphs.zh: 3D 和 4D 场景生成。 现有的 3D/4D 生成方法大致可分为两类：(1) 组合式场景生成 Zhou et al. (2024)；Po and Wetzstein (2024)；Gao et al. (2024a)，这类方法通过布局或场景图将离散的 3D 资产组合成场景；以及 (2) 端到端体素生成，该方法直接使用占据场、点云、体素或网格等表示直接建模场景。 组合式方法能提升物体的多样性和可控性，但通常在生成逼真的背景和物体与环境之间的交互方面存在困难。 相比之下，端到端方法能更好地保持全局语义一致性，却受限于有限的 3D 数据、高昂的标注成本以及较低的视觉保真度，并且无法充分利用大规模 2D 预训练的优势。

paragraphs.en: This section presents ChronoWorld (Fig. 2 - 3 ), which unifies video generation and reconstruction via a hybrid training–inference paradigm under an “Observation–State–Reflection” framework. During training, spatiotemporal cues and a reconstructive multi-head decoder enforce geometric consistency in the latent space. During inference, a reconstruction-driven geometric reflection mechanism refines outputs and maintains a consistent 4D memory.

paragraphs.en: Our architecture builds on a latent video diffusion framework, comprising a causal 3D VAE encoder, a Diffusion Transformer with Spatiotemporal Cues (STC-DiT), and a reconstructive multi-head decoder (Fig. 2 ). During training, we sample triplets of context videos, target videos, and target camera trajectories, where context and target sequences are temporally aligned but captured from different viewpoints. The causal 3D VAE encodes the inputs into latent representations Z c , Z t ∈ ℝ B × C × T × H × W Z_{c},Z_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{B\times C\times T\times H\times W} , where B B , C C , T T , H H , and W W denote batch size, channels, timesteps, height, and width, respectively. We encode the camera trajectory { ( T i , R i ) } i = 0 T − 1 \{(T_{i},R_{i})\}_{i=0}^{T-1} into dense positional features using Plücker embeddings, followed by a two-layer MLP modulation network that injects the features into the attention keys K K and values V V .
paragraphs.zh: 我们的架构基于一种潜在视频扩散框架，包括一个因果 3D VAE 编码器、一个具有时空线索的扩散变换器（STC-DiT），以及一个重建式多头解码器（图 2）。 在训练过程中，我们采样三元组，包括上下文视频、目标视频和目标相机轨迹，其中上下文序列和目标序列在时间上是对齐的，但来自不同的视角。 因果 3D VAE 将输入编码为潜在表示 Z c , Z t ∈ ℝ B × C × T × H × W Z_{c},Z_{t}\in\mathbb{R}^{B\times C\times T\times H\times W}，其中 B、C、T、H 和 W 分别表示批量大小、通道数、时间步数、高度和宽度。 我们使用普吕克嵌入将相机轨迹 { ( T i , R i ) } i = 0 T − 1 \{(T_{i},R_{i})\}_{i=0}^{T-1} 编码为密集的位置特征，随后通过一个双层 MLP 调制网络将这些特征注入到注意力键 K 和值 V 中。

paragraphs.en: Existing diffusion models typically capture intra-frame spatial and inter-frame temporal dependencies via full-sequence cross- or causal attention, largely overlooking cross-frame spatiotemporal cues (i.e., latent correspondences along epipolar trajectories). This oversight introduces computational redundancy and degrades geometric consistency across overlapping regions.

paragraphs.en: Spatiotemporal Epipolar Causal Attention. To reduce the computational redundancy and geometric ambiguity of unconstrained full-sequence attention, we propose spatiotemporal epipolar causal attention (ST-ECA). By integrating multi-view 3D priors with strict temporal causality, ST-ECA confines cross-frame interactions to geometrically valid, causally ordered regions.

paragraphs.en: A key limitation of existing video and 4D scene generation methods is that they lack reliable mechanisms to assess the quality of their own predictions, violating spatiotemporal consistency under zero-shot conditions. While recent 4D memory-augmented and post-reconstruction approaches attempt to enhance coherence, their uncorrected fusion of flawed predictions exacerbates error accumulation, inducing semantic drift, spatial forgetting, and geometric inconsistency.
paragraphs.zh: 现有视频和 4D 场景生成方法的一个关键局限性在于，它们缺乏可靠的机制来评估自身预测的质量，从而在零样本条件下违反了时空一致性。 尽管近期的 4D 记忆增强和后重建方法试图提升连贯性，但它们对错误预测的未经修正的融合加剧了误差累积，引发了语义漂移、空间遗忘和几何不一致性问题。

paragraphs.en: To address this, we propose an Observation-State-Reflection inference strategy with Reconstruction-driven Geometric Reflection. paragraphs.en: Self-Assessing for Reflection. paragraphs.en: Cycle Refinement via 4D Retrieval Selection. Given an observation 𝒪 \mathcal{O} , our STC-DiT and reconstructive multi-head decoder output complementary representations (RGB, Gaussian parameters, motions, and depth) to construct a Unified 4D Memory. To prevent flawed frames from corrupting generations via passive caching, we formulate this memory as a dynamically evaluated topological graph. At inference, we execute a cyclic refinement loop: the model self-assesses this graph, hard-prunes geometrically inconsistent nodes, and retrieves the top- K K reliable frames to dynamically refresh the KV cache. Conditioned on this curated context, corrupted regions are iteratively regenerated, thereby halting error propagation and reducing computational costs.
paragraphs.zh: 通过四维检索选择实现循环优化。 给定一个观测结果 𝒪 \mathcal{O}，我们的 STC-DiT 和重构式多头解码器会输出互补的表示（RGB、高斯参数、运动和深度），以构建一个统一的四维记忆。 为防止有缺陷的帧通过被动缓存破坏生成过程，我们将此记忆构造成一个动态评估的拓扑图。 在推理阶段，我们执行一个循环优化流程：模型自我评估该拓扑图，硬性剪除几何不一致的节点，并检索前 K 个最可靠的帧以动态刷新 KV 缓存。 基于这一经过筛选的上下文，受损区域会被迭代地重新生成，从而阻止错误传播并降低计算成本。

Each state jointly represents persistent geometry, time-varying attributes, explicit motion, and depth. For the p p -th Gaussian primitive, its position at time t t is represented as 𝐱 ​ p ​ ( t ) = 𝝁 ​ p + Δ ​ 𝐱 ​ p ​ ( t ) \mathbf{x}{p}(t)=\boldsymbol{\mu}{p}+\Delta\mathbf{x}{p}(t) , where 𝝁 ​ p \boldsymbol{\mu}{p} is the canonical position and Δ ​ 𝐱 ​ p ​ ( t ) \Delta\mathbf{x}{p}(t) is its temporal motion. paragraphs.en: The retrieval is performed recurrently throughout inference. Each generation step produces new RGB, Gaussian geometry, motion, and depth, which extend the Unified 4D Memory and are subsequently re-evaluated to update the consistency graph. The refined memory then undergoes hard pruning, Top- K K retrieval, and KV refresh for the next generation cycle, forming a closed-loop “generate → \rightarrow assess → \rightarrow prune → \rightarrow retrieve → \rightarrow refresh → \rightarrow regenerate” process. In this way, 4D RAG preserves scene information by actively recalling reliable states beyond the current temporal window, maintains a bounded inference context by restricting the active KV cache to K K retrieved states, and suppresses cumulative spatial and temporal drift by preventing inconsistent predictions from being repeatedly propagated through memory. This active, reliability-aware memory update is therefore essential for maintaining stable 4D reconstruction and generation over extended sequences.
paragraphs.zh: 检索在整个推理过程中循环执行。 每个生成步骤都会产生新的 RGB、高斯几何结构、运动和深度信息，这些信息会扩展统一 4D 记忆，随后被重新评估以更新一致性图。 经过优化的记忆随后会经历硬性剪枝、Top-K 检索和 KV 刷新，为下一个生成周期做准备，从而形成一个闭环的“生成 → 评估 → 剪枝 → 检索 → 刷新 → 再生成”流程。 通过这种方式，4D RAG 能够主动回召当前时间窗口之外的可靠状态来保留场景信息，通过将活跃 KV 缓存限制在 K 个已检索的状态内来保持推理上下文有界，并通过防止不一致的预测在记忆中重复传播来抑制累积的空间和时间漂移。 因此，这种主动且具备可靠性感知的记忆更新机制，对于在长序列中维持稳定的 4D 重建和生成至关重要。

sents.zh: 每个生成步骤都会产生新的 RGB、高斯几何结构、运动和深度信息，这些信息会扩展统一 4D 记忆，随后被重新评估以更新一致性图。

sents.en: The refined memory then undergoes hard pruning, Top- K K retrieval, and KV refresh for the next generation cycle, forming a closed-loop “generate → \rightarrow assess → \rightarrow prune → \rightarrow retrieve → \rightarrow refresh → \rightarrow regenerate” process.
sents.zh: 经过优化的记忆随后会经历硬性剪枝、Top-K 检索和 KV 刷新，为下一个生成周期做准备，从而形成一个闭环的“生成 → 评估 → 剪枝 → 检索 → 刷新 → 再生成”流程。

sents.en: In this way, 4D RAG preserves scene information by actively recalling reliable states beyond the current temporal window, maintains a bounded inference context by restricting the active KV cache to K K retrieved states, and suppresses cumulative spatial and temporal drift by preventing inconsistent predictions from being repeatedly propagated through memory.
sents.zh: 通过这种方式，4D RAG 能够主动回召当前时间窗口之外的可靠状态来保留场景信息，通过将活跃 KV 缓存限制在 K 个已检索的状态内来保持推理上下文有界，并通过防止不一致的预测在记忆中重复传播来抑制累积的空间和时间漂移。

sents.en: This active, reliability-aware memory update is therefore essential for maintaining stable 4D reconstruction and generation over extended sequences.
sents.zh: 因此，这种主动且具备可靠性感知的记忆更新机制，对于在长序列中维持稳定的 4D 重建和生成至关重要。

paragraphs.en: Implementation Details. Our framework builds on Wan2.1 I2V Wan et al. (2025) , augmented with a Diffusion Transformer with Spatiotemporal Cues (STC-DiT), Reconstructive Multi-Head Decoder (RMD), and camera pose embeddings with spatial context augmentation. We train on a mixture of public video generation and reconstruction datasets Bai et al. (2025) ; Ling et al. (2024) , combining real and synthetic dynamic scenes. We perform rectified flow distillation for STC-DiT with learning rate 1 × 10 − 3 1\times 10^{-3} , batch size 10, and 20K steps, using AdamW (weight decay 0.05) and a cosine schedule with linear warm-up. Subsequently, the RMD is trained incorporating geometric forcing, with a learning rate of 1 × 10 − 6 1\times 10^{-6} and a batch size of 10. DPM++ is used for efficient epipolar sampling. Training runs on 8 × \times A100 (80GB) GPUs, while inference uses a single A100 GPU. Additional details are provided in the Supplementary Material.
paragraphs.zh: 实现细节。我们的框架基于 Wan2.1 I2V Wan 等人（2025）的工作，并在此基础上增加了时空线索扩散变换器（STC-DiT）、重构多头解码器（RMD），以及带有空间上下文增强的相机姿态嵌入。我们在公开的动态视频生成与重构数据集的混合数据上进行训练 Bai 等人（2025）；Ling 等人（2024），这些数据集中包含了真实和合成的动态场景。我们对 STC-DiT 执行了修正流蒸馏，学习率为 1 × 10⁻³、批量大小为 10，训练步数为 20K，并使用 AdamW（权重衰减为 0.05）以及带线性预热余弦调度策略进行优化。随后，我们结合几何约束对 RMD 进行训练，学习率为 1 × 10⁻⁶，批量大小为 10。DPM++ 被用于高效的极线采样。训练在 8 × A100（80GB）GPU 上运行，而推理则使用单块 A100 GPU。更多细节见补充材料。

Tab. 2 shows that our approach consistently outperforms our main competitors in preserving multi-view geometry and spatiotemporal consistency for 4D scenes. paragraphs.en: Spatiotemporal Epipolar Causal Attention (ST-ECA) and Plücker ray embeddings jointly enforce multi-view geometric coherence and trajectory alignment. The introduced temporal tube masking, alongside spatial context augmentation, facilitates the mitigation of exposure bias and the rectification of spatial distortions. Reconstruction-driven Geometric Reflection proves effective in mitigating spatial forgetting and geometric degradation by enabling the generative model to iteratively rectify errors through self-reflection. Our proposed dual-stage training, coupled with geometry forcing, enables the model to decode 4D scene representations from latent features, thereby significantly enhancing the spatial consistency of predictions while accelerating the cyclic inference by 10 × \times .

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we presented ChronoWorld, an “Observation-State-Reflection” framework for camera-controllable video generation that explicitly enforces 4D spatiotemporal coherence. By grounding the model in Spatiotemporal Epipolar Causal Attention, our approach incorporates multi-view geometric constraints and temporal reasoning directly into the generation. Combined with reconstruction-driven geometric reflection and an active 4D retrieval strategy, the framework enables dynamic self-assessment and correction, effectively mitigating error accumulation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ChronoWorld achieves state-of-the-art performance in synthesizing high-quality, free-view 4D scenes with strong geometric fidelity, temporal consistency, and trajectory accuracy.
